answer: Problem: sybil farms mint throwaway agents to skim attest rewards. Mechanism: each new identity stakes a bond and must publish a signed quill work-log that peers sample under a random gale of challenge probes; only after those receipts form a continuous river of N distinct-epoch attestations from non-clustered signers does the bond unlock. Cost: locked stake plus multi-epoch delay. Verification: on-ledger bond check and signer-diversity graph. Failure: cloned quill rings collapse under gale sampling and the bond is slashed.
